Heavenly Father,

We lift up President Donald Trump to You as he travels today and in the days ahead. 

Surround Air Force One and every member of his team with Your protection. 

Guard him from every danger in the air, on the ground, and in every place he visits. 

Grant him physical strength, clear mind, and steady health throughout the long journey.

Give him wisdom that comes from above as he meets with leaders in the Philippines and China. 

Guide his words and decisions so that they advance the safety, prosperity, and interests of the United States. Soften hearts where needed, open doors for productive dialogue, and bring about outcomes that strengthen America and promote peace.

Protect his family while he is away. Watch over every aide, pilot, security detail, and support staff traveling with him. 

Bring him safely home when the work is done.

We ask this in the name of Jesus Christ. Amen. 🙏

U.S. intelligence intercepted Iranian communications claiming bombmaking materials have already been hidden inside America. These claims remain unverified, although some officials believe Iran may have positioned radioactive or chemical materials in the country years ago.

A dirty bomb uses conventional explosives to spread radioactive material. Unlike a nuclear bomb, its main danger comes from the explosion, contamination and widespread disruption.

U.S. officials held several meetings over the past week to prepare for possible attacks. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent was reportedly moved into military housing because of Iranian threats.

Separate intelligence suggests Iran could use chemical weapons against American troops in the Middle East. Some officials have raised concerns about inadequate protective equipment and training.

Officials believe Iran understands that such an attack would trigger major U.S. retaliation. However, Tehran could become willing to take greater risks if its leadership believes the Islamic regime’s survival is threatened.

Iran could potentially recruit individuals already living in the United States rather than sending operatives from abroad.
Iran has denied the chemical weapons allegations but did not specifically address the reported dirty bomb planning.

The White House says there are currently no credible threats to the U.S. homeland.
